# `m.forex.last_quote`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The latest best bid and ask of each currency pair.

```python
m.forex.last_quote(symbols)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol`; `mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND` also keys by `Timestamp` (`dm.PollMode.REPLACE`) |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Last Quote (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST: the request's `from` parameter. | REST |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the UTC date of `Timestamp`. | REST |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. From REST `timestamp`: "The Unix millisecond timestamp." | REST |
| `BidPrice` | double | The bid price. | REST |
| `AskPrice` | double | The ask price. | REST |
| `Exchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
